name: Hina Nii
source:
Between Amimi and Zuki, Hina is the liveliest of the three.  She’s not the quickest to understand certain scenarios, but is the fastest to be there when they need her.  Lover of all things electronic and her boyfriend, Takumi.  Hard to find her without her cell phone in hand.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
